text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament decided to delay local elections to 1999, The last municipal elections took place in 1963.
- Amnesty International accused Israel of unlawfully holding Lebanese nationals.
- The government discussed the possibility of issuing a $1 billion 30-year Eurobond.
- Israel and its local militia allies shelled areas in south Lebanon.
- The government nominated new members for the 10-member Constitutional Council.
- "Iraq will have no problem when Lebanon decides to restore diplomatic relations," Iraqi Information Minister Hammadi said.
